project.name: B1 Hope 39M experiment - LIVE TESTING
project.notes:
LIVE WORKFLOW ACCEPTANCE TEST — 2026-11-02. B1 Hope remains a reference offering only. Execution is a SMALL native ImpressionCore B3 text research configuration, NOT a verified B1 architecture or a 39M-parameter certification. Original project revision 1 backed up in src/memlog/live_workbench_20261102_184402/original_project.json. Inputs: 24 original synthetic engineering sentences for training, 8 distinct held-out sentences; existing local 28,000-token tokenizer. CPU, FP32, microbatch 1, bounded optimizer steps. Objective: one prefix-next-token target per record, not full causal LM. Purpose: exercise save/preflight/train/checkpoint/evaluate/generate/export and compatible fine-tuning; not language-quality benchmarking.

LIVE OUTCOME: scratch run c9af53851adf41dba966e2a560f66b8f completed 6/6 steps; compatible fine-tune run 71a68a5f9ccc460ba8e8d77880a03638 completed 2/2 steps. Measured parameter count: 4,567,641. Held-out prefix-target CE: scratch 10.262544 (PPL 28639.55), fine-tune 10.263847 (PPL 28676.90), 8 records each; no quality improvement demonstrated. Both checkpoints generated 16 new tokens; output incoherent as expected from this tiny scratch test. Native ZIP bundles and hashes independently verified; 104 state tensors changed after fine-tuning. Screenshots, inputs, original settings, exported configuration and report: src/memlog/live_workbench_20261102_184402. Browser download events were unavailable in the integrated tool; UI export fetched data and authenticated localhost downloads were saved separately.
